topic: Area and Perimeter of Complex Polygons
q: The figure is made of a square and a triangle that share one side. The perimeter of the whole figure (the largest polygon) is 40 centimeters. The perimeter of the square alone is 28 centimeters. What is the perimeter of the triangle alone?
key: Answer: C. The square's perimeter is 28, so each side is 7 cm. Three of the square's sides are on the outside of the figure (3 × 7 = 21 cm); the shared 4th side is internal and NOT part of the whole figure's perimeter. So the triangle's two outer sides total 40 − 21 = 19 cm. The triangle's own perimeter adds back the shared side: 19 + 7 = 26 cm.

topic: No Remainder when Divided by two given Numbers
q: If z can be divided by both 4 and 9 without leaving a remainder, then 2z can also be divided by which number without leaving a remainder?
key: Answer: A. z must be a multiple of 36 (since 4 and 9 share no common factor, the smallest number divisible by both is 4×9=36). So 2z is a multiple of 72. 24 divides 72 evenly (72 ÷ 24 = 3), so 24 always divides 2z. 16, 27, and 20 do not divide 72 evenly.

q: A spinner is divided into 8 equal sections: 3 red, 2 blue, and 3 yellow. If the spinner is spun once, what is the probability it lands on blue?
key: Answer: B. 2 blue sections out of 8 total = 28 = 14.

q: A bag contains only red and green marbles. The probability of picking a red marble at random is 37. If there are 12 red marbles, how many green marbles are in the bag?
key: Answer: D. If 37 of the marbles are red and there are 12 red marbles, the total is 12 ÷ 37 = 12 × 73 = 28 marbles. Green = 28 − 12 = 16.

q: A bookstore had 240 novels in stock. During a sale, 35% of the novels were sold. Of the novels that were NOT sold, 14 were paperbacks. How many of the unsold novels were paperbacks?
key: Answer: A. Sold: 35% of 240 = 84. Unsold: 240 − 84 = 156. Paperbacks (unsold only): 14 of 156 = 39. (B=84 is the number SOLD, not the quantity asked for -- re-read which group the question is about before finalizing.)

q: The floor of Room A is a square with area 196 ft². The floor of Room B is a rectangle that is 10 ft by 22 ft. Which room has the larger floor area, and by how much?
key: Answer: C. Room B's area = 10 × 22 = 220 ft². Room A's area = 196 ft² (since 14 × 14 = 196). 220 − 196 = 24 ft² -- Room B is larger by 24 ft².

q: A choir has 60 members. 25 of the members are altos, and 13 of the remaining members are sopranos. How many members are sopranos?
key: Answer: A. Altos: 25 of 60 = 24. Remaining: 60 − 24 = 36. Sopranos: 13 of 36 = 12. (B=24 is the number of ALTOS, not sopranos.)

q: Which of the following is NOT equivalent to 34?
key: Answer: D. 43 is the RECIPROCAL of 34, not an equivalent value (1.33 ≠ 0.75). 75%, 0.75, and 68 are all equal to 34.

topic: No Remainder when Divided by a given Number
q: A number is divisible by both 6 and 8 without a remainder. Which of the following must also divide that number without a remainder?
key: Answer: D. The smallest number divisible by both 6 and 8 is their LCM, 24 -- so the number is a multiple of 24. 12 divides 24 evenly (24 ÷ 12 = 2), so 12 always divides a multiple of 24. 16, 9, and 18 do not divide 24 evenly, so they are not guaranteed to work.
ref: Tier: Hard · Topic: No Remainder when Divided by a given Number · Diagram: yes · Wrong so far: 4/11 · Times practised before: 6 (last: set 7)

topic: Estimating Sums Differences of Decimal Numbers
q: Which expression gives the best estimate of 38.7 − 11.2?
key: Answer: B. Rounding to the nearest ten: 38.7 rounds up to 40 (since .7 rounds up), and 11.2 rounds down to 10 (since .2 rounds down). 40 − 10 is the best estimate. The other choices round at least one number the wrong direction.
